title: MotoGP Japan
metaDescription: MotoGP Japan is the premier motorcycle-racing weekend at Mobility Resort Motegi

overview.about: The Japanese Grand Prix is held at the Mobility Resort Motegi, a stop-start circuit owned by Honda north of Tokyo. Its heavy braking zones and short straights make it hard on brakes and a key home venue for the Japanese manufacturers who have shaped the sport. The 2026 race is on 24-26 September.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Japanese Grand Prix runs 24-26 September at Motegi. The point-and-squirt layout puts a premium on braking stability and traction out of slow corners, and it is a proud home round for Honda and Yamaha.
